The structure of Cs2K4Ti4I18 (reduced formula CsK2Ti2I9) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Ti centers coordinated by six I neighbors, while K and Cs each show nine-fold coordination by I. Iodine centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 28 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ti octahedra and face-sharing between Cs and K coordination polyhedra.
